meaning:
ἀλαζών, -όνος, ὁ, ἡ
(ἄλη, wandering) [in LXX: Job.28:8 (שַׁחַץ) Hab.2:5 (יָהִיר), Pro.21:24 (לוּץ)* ;]
prop, a vagabond, hence, an impostor, a boaster: Rom.1:30, 2Ti.3:2.†
SYN.: ὐβριστής, ὑπερήφανος (see Tr., Syn., § xxix; Lft., Notes, 256) (AS)

elsewhere.note: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
